Problem description:
# m06_factcop

Prove that for every integer $n \ge 1$, the numbers $n! + 1$ and $(n+1)! + 1$
are coprime:
$$\gcd\bigl(n! + 1,\; (n+1)! + 1\bigr) = 1.$$

Prove the theorem `m06_factcop`. Key idea: any common divisor $d$ also divides
$(n+1)(n!+1) - \bigl((n+1)!+1\bigr) = n$, hence divides $n!$, hence divides
$(n!+1) - n! = 1$.

```lean
import Mathlib

/-- For every `n ≥ 1`, the numbers `n! + 1` and `(n + 1)! + 1` are coprime. -/
theorem m06_factcop (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Nat.Coprime (Nat.factorial n + 1) (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1) := by
  -- we prove the gcd is `1`
  apply (Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one).2
  -- let `g` be the gcd
  set g := Nat.gcd (Nat.factorial n + 1) (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1) with hg
  have h₁ : g ∣ Nat.factorial n + 1 := by
    have := Nat.gcd_dvd_left (Nat.factorial n + 1) (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1)
    simpa [hg] using this
  have h₂ : g ∣ Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1 := by
    have := Nat.gcd_dvd_right (Nat.factorial n + 1) (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1)
    simpa [hg] using this
  -- `g` also divides `(n+1)*(n!+1)`
  have hmul : g ∣ (n + 1) * (Nat.factorial n + 1) :=
    Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h₁ (n + 1)
  -- an inequality needed for `Nat.dvd_sub`
  have hle : Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1 ≤ (n + 1) * (Nat.factorial n + 1) := by
    have h_one_le : (1 : ℕ) ≤ n + 1 := Nat.succ_le_succ hn
    calc
      Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1
          = (n + 1) * Nat.factorial n + 1 := by
            simpa [Nat.factorial_succ] using rfl
      _ ≤ (n + 1) * Nat.factorial n + (n + 1) := by
            exact Nat.add_le_add_left h_one_le _
      _ = (n + 1) * (Nat.factorial n + 1) := by
            simpa [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
  -- from the two divisibilities we get `g ∣ n`
  have hgn : g ∣ n := by
    have h := Nat.dvd_sub hmul h₂ hle
    have hsub :
        (n + 1) * (Nat.factorial n + 1) - (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1) = n := by
      calc
        (n + 1) * (Nat.factorial n + 1) - (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1)
            = (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + (n + 1)) - (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1) := by
              simpa [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one,
                Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
        _ = (n + 1) - 1 := by
              simpa using Nat.add_sub_add_left (Nat.factorial (n + 1)) (n + 1) 1
        _ = n := by
              simpa [Nat.succ_sub_one]
    simpa [hsub] using h
  -- `n` divides `n!`
  have hnfact : n ∣ Nat.factorial n := Nat.dvd_factorial (Nat.le_refl n)
  have hgn_fact : g ∣ Nat.factorial n := Nat.dvd_trans hgn hnfact
  -- now `g` divides the difference `(n!+1) - n! = 1`
  have h_one : g ∣ 1 := by
    have h := Nat.dvd_sub h₁ hgn_fact (Nat.le_succ _)
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using h
  have hg_one : g = 1 := Nat.dvd_one.mp h_one
  simpa [hg] using hg_one
```

```lean
    Nat.Coprime (Nat.factorial n + 1) (Nat.factorial (n + 1) + 1) := by
```

```lean
  simpa [hd, this] using rfl
```
